referral.title: Referral Program
referral.inviteHint: When someone signs up through your link, you earn commission on their eligible spend.
referral.ruleItem1: You earn commission in real time on each referral's eligible paid usage. (Refunded charges are reversed, and bonus or promo credits do not qualify.)
referral.ruleItem2: Earnings are credited to your Reward Balance, which is used before your Main Balance for model usage. Rewards cannot currently be withdrawn.
referral.ruleItem3: There is no cap on total earnings. Rates and spend thresholds are set by ModelGo and shown on this page.
referral.ruleItem4: Self-referrals, duplicate accounts from the same device or IP address, and unusual spending patterns may be reviewed. Rewards associated with confirmed abuse may be frozen or revoked.
referral.gateDesc: Make your first top-up to unlock your personal referral link and start earning real-time commission.
